implementation_summary: LearnStats freezes estimates/publication time, allocates at most eight positive safe numeric versions with create-only R2 writes, and validates exact key, bounded nonblank ETag and final UTF-8 size before awaited live KV publication. Only null advances a collision; malformed or thrown acknowledgement stops.

Publication failures explicitly rearm at now+30s and fail, including scheduling failure. State/prior/snapshot refusals retain their prior semantics; counters are not replayed or reset on publication failure, and ambiguous KV/reset effects never claim applied:false.

Actual operator publish/reset handlers require HTTP plus coherent success before returning success or appending the reset revision. Failed acknowledgement returns sanitized no-store503; normal empty publication and acknowledged reset/audit revision remain supported.

Exactly three grouped additions cover publisher ordering/failures/collisions/restart/reset, actual old/new live winners with retained archives and real replayDeps/replayDecision, and authenticated operator outcomes. Existing bounded/normal publication fixtures now provide conditional R2 acknowledgement metadata.
